Theorem
[Integer dimension and regularity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0426, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0427 1. appG:G.40,appG:G.42\group Aleksandrov structure The Hausdorff dimension of an Aleksandrov space is a finite nonnegative integer. If its dimension is $n$, an open dense subset is homeomorphic to an $n$-manifold.
